question: Which packets and multiplicities belong to ordinary Lacrimosa Skill/Burst casts?
stop_condition: Identify packets/multiplicities from saved descriptions and native arrays; use a disclosed bounded timing hypothesis if intervals are absent.
return_condition: New timing/reachability evidence changes Morning Tomato 1x Skill or Working Day Judgement 4x UltraSkill1 + 1x UltraSkill2, Nightmare DoT ticks, or Truck variants.
decision: Morning Tomato describes 1 instance totaling 300.0% at Lv1, matching native GE_Player_Lacrimosa_Skill1_Damage. Working Day Judgement describes 5 instances in Car mode totaling 94.2%*4 + 623.3% at Lv1, matching native GE_Player_Lacrimosa_UltraSkill1_Damage (4 hits) and GE_Player_Lacrimosa_UltraSkill2_Damage (1 hit). Require each action's primary packet; schedule children once after admission with the admitted effective native coordinate. Each hit settles independently; A2 (+15% dmg after QTE) applies across eligible hits, and resonance_6 (20% DEF ignore) shreds DEF for all damage.
timing_hypothesis: lacrimosa.skill_burst_packets_v1: ordered coincident delivery on target zero at selected primary impact time. This supports packet totals and ownership, not native frame timing. Same-time delivery precedes queued gear callbacks; timing-sensitive results retain this assumption.
checks: Independent content damage oracles: at 1000 ATK/DEF.5/RES0, Skill levels 1/8/effective9 total 1500/1, 5141/2, 5553/2; Burst levels 1/8/effective9 total 10001/2, 8569/1, 18513/2 (10285/1 at A6 with 20% DEF ignore).
Pending horizons, off-field ownership, dead/lethal targets, and alternate primary are checked. Strict requires matching hypothesis acceptance.

Description and native arrays agree at all nine levels. Public QTE/Skill/Burst rotation produces 7 hits and spends 120 energy; CLI/WASM/Worker agree. Full content, relevant character/gear web suites, replay and modeled awakening verifier pass.
No full kit/readiness claim. Normal chains, blood DoT mechanics (Blood_Damage), Pan/Air/Evade variants, and Discord cycle auto-trigger remain pending.
